title: A Phase II Clinical Study on the Efficacy and Safety of SHR-2173 Injection in the Treatment of Patients With Active Lupus Nephritis
off: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multicenter Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of SHR-2173 Injection in Patients With Active Lupus Nephritis
summary: The study is a Phase II clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SHR-2173 in patients with lupus nephritis (LN). It adopts a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial design.

primary.m: The ratio of 24-hour urine protein-creatinine ratio (24-hour UPCR) to the baseline.
